system.description: The dimwalker has chosen to indulge in the religion of the Tenet of Nid and can learn to invoke the god Gave to activate supernatural powers. By getting the Holy Tablet (the Tenet of Nid) specialty , the dimwalker can activate the divine powers of the learned Holy Tablet. The specialty provides +2 in Skill Value per level for performing prayers, which in turn provides the gavlian with additional temporary Divinity Points. By choosing this specialty , the character forfeits the opportunity to acquire any of the specialties of other religions.
system.summary: Dedicates the conjurer to the Nid Doctrine: invoking the god Gave through its Sacred Tablet.
